scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Ah! Hey! Man!
What's up?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Have you ever heard of horrific human experimentation committed in Rekenber Corporation whose head office is here in Lighthalzen?
Whaaat?! human experimentation?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text:
Yea! human experimentation!!
There are a lot of rumors that horrible human experimentation is actually performed, but these people in the slum....don't want to believe that due to the welfare movement from Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Well! and those rich people, seem to know something but they never mention that...

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Ahh!! And this is a secret that just SOME PEOPLE know. I heard that from Rekenber Lab.,.. a person named...um...Wol....

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Anyway!! A scientist named Wolf.. something suddenly got sacked. and he must be related with this rumor, I think...
You mean... Wolfchev?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Ohhhh?! yeah Wolfchev!! That's right, the name was Wolfchev.. The mad scientist..

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: I suppose you can then understand the story faster... I am sure that he's involved in the rumor. I swear.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: By the way..what about you? Is there anything that you know about him?
Pretend you know nothing.
Tell him what you know.
Not really. I've ever heard of his name, but I don't know anything about him..

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Hm.... You sound suspicious, dude! huh?
He happens to research into Human 'Homunculus' without telling that to Rekenber Corp., and there was a whistle-blower who reported to the corp. so he was fired.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Oh! Man..! You seem to know pretty much! By any chance, are you concerned with Rekenber??

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Don't worry. I didn't mean anything.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text:
Well! I am just curious only because some people in the slum and some adventurers were missing,
and I heard that Rekenber was doing human experimentation with those missing people. Hope you don't get me wrong.

Actually, it is not a funny rumor.
Should investigate the lab where the experiment was carried out.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Oh! What a beautiful lady!!

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: How come a beauty is here, in a place with dangerous rumor?
Walking...
To hang out...
Shopping...

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Ahh.. Lady, you are so graceful even when you are just walking.....

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Lady. You are a dignified lady even if you hang out in this poor town...

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Ahh.. Lady.. Shopping in the slum!!.. Are you a type who needs to look around every single shop?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Well, how dare I ask you and be interested in what the lady does...

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: I just hope that the lady gets out of this town with dangerous rumors..
Dangerous rumors?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Ah... Lady may not have heard of the rumor.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Recently, some people from this town, actually from the slum...and some adventurers are missing...

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: and then the rumor came up, since disappearance cases happen pretty often, that Rekenber is committing a horrible human experimentation in their secret lab.
Excuse me?! human experimentation?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text:
Yea! human experimentation!!
There are a lot of rumors that horrible human experimentation is actually performed, but these people in the slum....don't want to believe that due to the welfare movement from Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Well! the rich people either want to believe..I think.. Ah!! And couple of weeks ago. um. what's his name? Wolfchev??

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Anyway!! that research got fired from the lab. I think he must be involved with this rumor.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: So, please, lady. Please don't be in a place like this and stay in safe ways.

............ It seems a pretty serious matter.
Should investigate the lab where the experiment was carried out.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Take care yourself and don't disappear!

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Be careful, Lady.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text:
Only those beautiful ladies are the reason of my life~!
I, Giacomo Girolamo Casanova de Seingalt am never interested in guys like you though!!

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: but I can listen to you...you wanna say anything to me?
No..?
About ladies..
You Womanizer!!
Envy you...
What's the rumor lately?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Hey you, get out of my way then..

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: I don't feel like talking about my precious ladies making fun of them. You do it with your friends.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Hey.. Excuse me!!! but I'm not a 'Womanizer', I am just a person who adores ladies.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Of course..... Yea... If I'm a womanizer, all the men on earth are too! I'm just Casanova. umhahahaha.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Haa.. Do you....? not have any woman but your sister and mother around you?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Oh...... sorry.. I got your point....

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: You.. are not like how you seem? Interesting..

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Yea, actually recently a lot of people from the slum and some wandering adventurers got disappeared. and I don't know why.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: You gotta be careful too..

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Hey, lady?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Wasn't it painful when you fell down from Heaven, my Angel?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: You must be tired. Because you are always wandering my mind.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Are you not tired of walking around in my dream last night?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Excuse me. But I think I lost my heart. Could you please borrow me yours?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Do you believe in love at first sight?? Or can we start again..?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: I am so sorry but, can you kiss with a person who just met?? Noo? Ok then let me introduce myself.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: I'm so lost here since it's the first time. Can you let me know which is the way to your heart?

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Give me a map please.. To get a way....I'm fallen in your eyes.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Your eyes....I wanna be forever there.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: I promise that I will be your everything in any case, in any difficult situation.

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Today is the first day we met, but I love you, Lady <3

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: Today is the first day we met, but I love you, Lady <3

scripts.speaker: Giacomo Girolamo
scripts.text: And I am telling you this because I'm just worried about you. You need to get out of this town which is full of disappearance cases.
In order to investigate human experimentation, I had to go down whilst I didn't want to because of gruesome sound.

- Whistling sound -
From below, there comes a gruesome sound mingling with the wind.
I arrived at a research facility which seems it has been used till these days.
There are some destroyed part, but the basic facility seem fine.
Get around a little more...
You!!!! are Wolfchev?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: A Human! kaahaha. People tend to hate this place, why are you here?
You!!! I heard that you were committing human experimentation. Wolfchev!!
And I see that you are still committing that!!!

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text:
Kihihihi. I can see that you know something about me. Is that you who accused me?
How dare you come back to me after you did that. Kihihih

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text:
I feel good to see a human
in a long time, but I gotta go. Kihihihi.
- Wolfchev ran away giving a awkward laughing sound. -
Whoa! Wolfchev, stop!
^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: (Gasping) Pshaw... you are still following me. Hey, why do you keep following me?
Wolfchev.. You said before. that you are doing research for everybody.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: I might have said that.... so what?
But, your experiment seem really dangerous. How come this is what everybody wants?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Everyone has a desire to be stronger and wants to dominate others so those other people obey and admire you. Do you not have that desire?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: If you want to save yourself, should stop following me. Bugger off.
Wolfchev is again running away with a strange sound.
Awwww!! You!! running away again..... Stop!
^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: You are pretty persistent, aren't you? Or I think.......that you like me, huh? Kihihii.
Wolfchev mocked you at your silence and pressed a button in his hand. Then guinea pigs woken up around him.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Again.. it's time to say goodbye.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Well! May be....

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: If you come to me for the experimentation, I can treat you better.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Oh my,... What happened?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: No! Don't come to me! Don't!!
First of all, I gotta handle those guinea pigs!
Wolfchev is confused and has no idea now since those monsters are attacking him too.
- Hit him to wake him up -

Yes I do!!
Umm.. No..

scripts.speaker: Researcher

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: Stop wondering here, and be on your way. Will you? Khh Khh.

Hey, is there any way to stop those creatures? You should know something, you made those things!

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: What is wrong with this whole thing?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev

Hey! Wolfchev!!

You!? Hey, please stop them!
Creatures are ^9f6077organically connected with same job field^000000.

There is one special creature being their ^46B951boss position^000000...
If you could deactivate that creature, all ^A1BB44slave creatures^000000 walking around here will stop moving right away.

Boss creature?
Hey! Wolfchev! Where is that ^46B951Boss creature^000000?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Inside.. of laboratory.. It should be waken up now. It's sad to destroy my life of work, but I can't take this any more.. ...
How can I get into the Wolfchev's laboratory?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text:
Oh.. Wait!
I will help you get in there.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Good news is that boss creatures are not set up to wake up all at once, even though slaves are.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text:
But still, it is really dangerous since we don't know when they will escape from there.
So, please prepare your party members, and take care of those boss creatures. I'm not sure how long this place can hold.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Are you all set there? I will prepare the entrance if you are the leader of that party.
Any warnings?
Going into the laboratory
Do not enter

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: I didn't know pressing the emergency alarm would cause such problem. The management system seems to be changed to emergency mode.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: There are so many systems set up inside of the laboratory, so eve I cannot be sure how systems are twisted by now.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Ah! If the emergency system is activating, only the leader of party should control everything. It is a lot of pressure I understand.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: And just so you know, please do not touch random things out of curiosity. I don't want you to get hurt.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but it seems you still cannot enter to the laboratory yet. Will you come back later? The system is kind of tricky you know.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: You came back, Ka Ha Ha.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev

What was that?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: All those boss creatures you took care of started to regenerate themselves..
What.. How is that possible...?!

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: I am also completely lost here.. But, this should not be happening..

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: As you can see, you are the only one I can trust. Would you and your party help me once again deactivating those creatures?
I am not sure
Why not

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text:
Thank you very much. {0}

scripts.text: You finally defeated my Boss creature.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Finally. is this the result?? For whom did I experiment? Did they cheat me?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: The button was supposed to be pressed for an emergency case...but..

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Hey... You and I met by a bad connection....

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: But...., you helped me... How could you do that?
When I met you for the first time, you seemed mad but sad, even if you could commit those cruel and horrific experiments.
But actually, you did that because you was lonely,.. you just concentrated on that for this reason, huh?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: HAHAHAHA. Loneliness... you say?

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: It might be seen like that to you. But, it isn't. Loneliness is just a good and easy excuse of the losers.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: I'm so happy doing experiments pursuing for a perfection, I never feel lonely.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: Anyway, since I realized that Rekenber betrayed me, I cannot just let them do what they want.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: For now, I will leave them alone, but I will make them cry and regret for trying to remove Wolfchev.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: aaaaaah, {0} Thank you so much to remove my boys who had gone mad. Not a big gift but I wish you don't deny, I don't need this anymore.

scripts.speaker: Wolfchev
scripts.text: And, if you can...hope you to come back often, especially with your friends. I want the place to be with human heart again so the sadness in here gets disappear.
I looked at Wolfchev again before leaving his lab. and I could feel that he was not obsessed anymore..
